purpose: Research-only affiliate candidate backlog for owner review. This file is not an affiliate partner registry, application, approval, contract, tracking configuration, or publication authorization.

publication_prohibition.reason: No candidate may be added to public pages, the public deployment manifest, or the hardened partner registry until each required owner-approved transition and verification is complete.
required_before_publication: provider acceptance and assigned tracking identifier
active owner decisions covering affiliate_tracking_changes and publishing

exclusive_department_policy.policy: Executive Advertising (EA-001, affiliate ID 1056) remains the only permitted promotional merchandise affiliate. This research backlog must not add or research a competing promotional merchandise referral.

department_backlog.launch_criteria: Executive Advertising attribution and offer terms remain separately unverified; follow PP-012 and PP-016. No competing merchandise candidates are permitted.
Select one or more accepted, tracking-verified partners; publish only a complete department page with neutral selection guidance, disclosures, and owner publication authorization.
Use a verified affiliate link only after application, acceptance, tracking verification, content review, disclosure review, and owner publication authorization.
Research official publisher programs, regional eligibility, paid-social restrictions, and disclosure requirements before selecting any candidate.
Confirm the then-current Impact agreement, assigned link, tracked conversion rules, and approved educational content before any public recommendation.
Confirm regional program eligibility, the current Partnerise campaign terms, approved links, and a non-misleading design-tool guide before publication.
Confirm application acceptance, permitted promotional channels, link tracking, and a workflow-led CRM guide before owner-approved publication.
Confirm eligibility by region, PartnerStack offer terms, tracked link behavior, and a non-advisory bookkeeping-tool guide before publication.
Confirm account requirements, affiliate-code ownership, paid-search restrictions, tracking, and an original workflow-planning guide before publication.
Publish only after the automation candidate is accepted and verified, with operational use-case content and the same tracking and disclosure controls.
Research official programs and jurisdiction-specific employment, payroll, privacy, and paid-search limitations before candidate selection.
Research official programs and verify data-processing, service claims, regional availability, and affiliate terms before candidate selection.
Research official programs only after a security-claims review; do not publish recommendations without verified capability, pricing, and regional terms.
Research official programs, educator eligibility, credential claims, and refund restrictions before candidate selection.
Research official programs, service-area coverage, commercial-account requirements, and shipping-claim restrictions before candidate selection.
Confirm jurisdiction coverage, Awin acceptance, assigned link, tracking, and legal-claim review before publishing an educational business-formation resource.

No incentives or cashback to prospects; paid advertising and direct-linking require prior written or email consent.

candidates.name: Hostinger

restrictions: Affiliate account verification is required before using the dashboard.
Do not use iframes or other technology that places a tracking cookie without a real click.

published_terms.qualification: The agreement source is a localized official page; owner review must confirm the governing terms for PromoPalaces' jurisdiction before application.

candidates.proposed_content: Small-business website launch planning guide that compares requirements without price, uptime, or feature claims.

restrictions: The program prioritizes applicants with an active website, an established merchant audience, original commerce or entrepreneurship content, and relevant experience.

published_terms.qualification: Location-specific payout tables and the current program terms must be reconfirmed in the affiliate application and Impact account.

candidates.proposed_content: Ecommerce launch decision guide covering catalog, fulfillment, payments, and support readiness without product endorsements until approved.
